steps.title: Show the open, empty box
steps.action: Place the open box under the camera with nothing inside.

steps.title: Position the divider
steps.action: Stand the book upright across the middle of the box as the divider, then approve the two zones.

steps.title: Pack the left compartment
steps.action: Place the mouse and the highlighter in the left compartment.

steps.title: Pack the right compartment
steps.action: Place the bundled cable and the power bank in the right compartment.

steps.title: Inspect before closing
steps.action: Keep the lid open and take one photo of the whole interior.
